grammar.0.note: As before: the main part is in second place; ab/an/um go to the end.
grammar.1.title: Ticket and station words
grammar.2.title: Delays and announcements
grammar.2.text: „Der Zug hat zehn Minuten Verspätung.“ = The train is ten minutes late. Station announcements give the time on the 24-hour clock (acht Uhr fünfzehn). After buying a ticket, check the platform (Gleis) number and the time; in many places you have to stamp your ticket before departure, otherwise you can be fined.
quiz.6.prompt: How do you say “return ticket” in German?
quiz.6.why: hin und zurück = there and back (return).
